'''June 2000 Las Vegas tournament (30 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Triple J's, Las Vegas on 30 June 2000. It is known from Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d956">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vegas-noise-factor-6-30d956/ vegas-noise-factor-6-30], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 1 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vegas-noise-factor-6-30d956/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Triple J's, Las Vegas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
